title: KinyaEmbed: Contrastive Sentence Embeddings for Kinyarwanda via Multi-Stage Curriculum Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.26941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present KinyaEmbed, the first dedicated sentence embedding model for Kinyarwanda, a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda. Existing multilingual embedding models such as LaBSE, mE5-large, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large perform poorly on Kinyarwanda due to severe under-representation in their pre-training corpora. KinyaEmbed is built on KinyaBERT-large and trained via a four-stage curriculum using MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (MNRL): Stage 1 leverages ~18,000 paraphrase pairs from the Official Gazette of Rwanda with three temperature scales; Stage 2 fine-tunes on 715 NLLB-translated MNLI triplets for entailment structure; Stage 3 aligns representations using English-Kinyarwanda OPUS-100 translation pairs; Stage 4 refines with 2,936 high-quality pairs filtered from KinyaCOMET at quality threshold 0.8. We evaluate on SemRel2024-rw and introduce Wiki-RW-STS, a new contamination-free Kinyarwanda

translated_title: KinyaEmbed：通过多阶段课程训练实现基尼亚卢旺达语的对比句嵌入
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26941v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了KinyaEmbed，这是首个专门针对基尼亚卢旺达语的句子嵌入模型，基尼亚卢旺达语是一种形态丰富的班图语言，在卢旺达有超过1200万人使用。现有的多语言嵌入模型如LaBSE、mE5-large和OpenAI text-embedding-3-large，由于在预训练语料中严重代表性不足，在基尼亚卢旺达语上表现不佳。KinyaEmbed基于KinyaBERT-large构建，并通过使用MultipleNegativesRankingLoss（MNRL）的四阶段课程进行训练：第一阶段利用来自卢旺达官方公报的约18,000对释义对，采用三种温度尺度；第二阶段在715个NLLB翻译的MNLI三元组上进行微调，以学习蕴含结构；第三阶段使用英语-基尼亚卢旺达语OPUS-100翻译对对齐表示；第四阶段使用从KinyaCOMET中过滤的2,936个高质量配对（质量阈值0.8）进行优化。我们在SemRel2024-rw上进行了评估，并引入了Wiki-RW-STS，这是一个新的无污染基尼亚卢旺达语数据集。
tldr: 本文提出了首个专门针对基尼亚卢旺达语的句子嵌入模型KinyaEmbed，通过四阶段课程训练显著提升了该语言在语义相似度任务上的性能，并引入了无污染评估数据集Wiki-RW-STS。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces KinyaEmbed, the first dedicated sentence embedding model for Kinyarwanda, trained via a four-stage curriculum to significantly improve semantic similarity performance, along with a new contamination-free evaluation dataset Wiki-RW-STS.
